d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 31 properties, including 33 signature F&B restaurants, across the Middle East, Europe, Asia and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and luxury residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Jumeirah Messilah Beach is uniquely located in a secluded area with easy access to Kuwait’s Central Business District, airport, and major Kuwait attractions. The resort features 316 rooms and suites, 79 residential suites, and 10 villas totalling 405 units. The beachfront hotel features an impressive array of exceptional dining destinations, including the Garden Café all-day dining restaurant, Pepper Steakhouse, Olio Trattoria Italiana, Mint Café, and The Lobby Lounge for a relaxing afternoon tea.

Setting new standards for holistic relaxation and luxurious comfort, the award-winning Talise Spa at Jumeirah Messilah Beach features a stunning Himalayan Salt Room, the first of its kind in the Middle East, built with pure crystal salt in its natural state. The spa also comprises dedicated ladies' and men’s areas with an extensive range of treatment rooms, including two private suites.
Superior conference and banqueting facilities mark Jumeirah Messilah Beach as the perfect venue for meetings and events.
q: Should have 2-year minimum experience in Sports & Leisure in a five-star hotel.
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to deal with guest enquiries and complaints confidently
r: p
An opportunity has arisen for a Guest Service Assistant to join the Sports & Leisure Teamat Jumeirah Messilah Beach. The main duties and responsibilities of this role are:
li
Welcoming guests and providing friendly, professional customer service.
li
Assisting guests with enquiries about sports facilities, leisure activities, memberships, opening hours, and available services.
li
Handling guest complaints and resolving problems promptly, escalating serious issues to management when necessary.
li
Managing bookings and reservations for sports facilities, classes, courts, activities, and events.
li
Carrying out reception duties, including guest check-in, registration, telephone enquiries, and email enquiries.
li
Providing guests with access cards, locker keys, towels, wristbands, and sports equipment where required.
li
Supporting the smooth operation of sports, fitness, and leisure activities.
li
Coordinating with coaches, instructors, lifeguards, security, housekeeping, and other operational teams.
li
Following health, safety, security, and emergency procedures to help maintain a safe environment.
li
Monitoring guest areas and reporting maintenance, cleanliness, equipment, or safety issues.
li
Processing payments for memberships, activities, facility hire, and other services.
li
Promoting sports programs, fitness classes, memberships, events, and special offers to guests.
li
Maintaining accurate booking, payment, guest, and administrative records.
li
Collecting guest feedback and communicating suggestions or recurring concerns to supervisors and management.
li
Maintaining a professional appearance, positive attitude, and high standard of customer service at all times.
x: We offer an attractive tax-free salary, paid in dinar (KWD), the local currency of Kuwait. In addition, we offer generous F&B benefits, reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, 30 days of annual leave, flights home, accommodation, life insurance, a monthly service charge, and other employee benefits, making the role attractive to high performers and any applicant looking for a career with one of the most luxurious brands in the hospitality industry.
